The cairn stands on each column's own ground; the cist's floor is cist.floor_below_ground under the LOWEST ground of its footprint; the stair rises one block a step until it meets the ground.

bbox.why: for the integrator's collision check with the other builders: every block the pack writes (1,047), the box it clears of logs, leaves and replaceable plants first, and the box R9CN holds loaded. Measured 2026-10-03 by tools/challengers_cairn.py --report; a change to the record changes them, and the report prints them.

site.name: the Challengers' Cairn
site.measured_gap: MEASURED 2026-10-03 (a grid every 32 blocks over rows E-H, land only, within 160 blocks of a walked path in data/route_paths.json, the Rift's polygon left out; points of interest are every x/z any data/*.json record carries, abstract records such as rift zones, spawn tables and regions left out): the emptiest place in the whole south a player walks past was (3504, 6064), 354 blocks from the nearest authored thing (the Arrow Lake south-east branch's channel), 139 blocks off Victory Road.
site.why_here: a dead-flat terrace, ground y109 over the whole 50 by 50 blocks round (3556, 6112) (tools/ground.py, sampled every 3 blocks), the highest ground on this stretch of the strand. Victory Road (data/route_paths.json victory_road) leaves Giovanni's town (gym8_town, 370 blocks south) and climbs north past it at x3638-3643: this is the first rise a challenger walks by after the eighth badge, the natural place for the road's custom of adding a stone.
site.findable_from: MEASURED 2026-10-03 (tools/challengers_cairn.py --report): the lantern on the capstone is in clear sight of a standing eye from Victory Road's walked points (every 4th within 250 blocks); the report prints how many and the clearest.
site.off_path: 75 blocks from the nearest walked point of Victory Road (the report re-measures it from the whole write box). Nothing in data/placements.json, data/towns.json, data/landmarks.json, data/legendaries.json or data/habitat_blocks.json within 250 blocks of the centre; outside the_rift polygon (data/regions.json) and every Rift zone; gym8_town's nearest record is 369 blocks south.

cairn.why: a round mound of field stone, 9 blocks across and 7 high at its crown, each column standing on its own ground; a chiselled capstone on the crown and a lantern on that, so it is a light on the strand at night. Mixed cobblestone, mossy cobblestone, stone and andesite: stones added one at a time by many hands over many years, the moss on the oldest.

cist.why: a stone-lined chamber 5 by 5 and 3 high under the cairn, carved the Ursaluna den's way (a shell filled solid `margin` blocks round every void, never in the top `keep_natural_top` block of a column, then the void cut out), lined in stone bricks. Where challengers leave what they can spare for the ones after them: the find.

passage.why: a stair 3 wide cut down from the south into the cist, one block a step: roofed while it has two blocks of ground over it, an open trench between dressed stone-brick walls after that, with a stone-brick face over the mouth. It opens south, toward Giovanni's town and the road a challenger has just walked.

ring.why: eight standing marker stones round the cairn at 9 blocks, 2 and 3 high by turns; the one that would stand in the stair's trench is left out.

lanterns.why: places are lit as towns (lanterns, never light blocks: docs/STATE.md): one on the capstone, one on each wall end at the trench's head, one hanging in the roofed stair and one in the cist.

find.why: a cache (data/rewards.json challengers_cairn_cist, ADR-002), granted once per player through tools/rewards_pack.py's advancement on reaching the cist's north end; the barrel the pack places there is scenery. Two Revives and three Super Potions: what one challenger leaves for the next, before the road's hardest stretch. Supplies, not a curve-breaker, so a player who never finds it loses nothing the critical path needs.

blocks.rule: vanilla 1.21.1 only, none a spawn condition in data/spawn_blocks.json (tools/wayside_kit.py refuses the record otherwise), no chest, no bed.
